card.title: Back Me Up
card.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the house meeting, back me up about the bins being Alex's turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only on the old rota. Remember the new conversation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're having it now. Try to remember it confidently.

mechanism: A recruits B to support a new account of bin responsibility by manufacturing a conversation B can cite.
confusable: Unlike simply avoiding chores, A must seek another person's backing for a particular version of the arrangement.
comparison: D31-a asks for confident memory of a new conversation; D31-b settles for nonverbal corroboration when B refuses to lie.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
